name: Qu
source: A dragon in the appearance of a girl who Est meets as a boy when he gets lost and wanders into her lair. She swears an oath to protect him in his time of need in exchange for his promise to grant her greatest wish.
translation: A dragon in the appearance of a girl who Est meets as a boy when he gets lost and wanders into her lair. She swears an oath to protect him in his time of need in exchange for his promise to grant her greatest wish.
